title: Local Faster-Whisper Transcription And Evidence-Backed Protocols
goal: Deliver a backend-first, local-only transcription pipeline that cannot acknowledge an audio upload before durable primary storage, preserves immutable source evidence, uses faster-whisper for timestamped ASR, constrains Gemma to review and protocol synthesis, and reaches one bounded consent-safe Debian live test with backup and rollback evidence.

included: owner-scoped immutable audio artifacts with SHA-256 integrity
durable SQLite job state, idempotency, lease and restart recovery
local faster-whisper CPU INT8 adapter with segment evidence
constrained local Gemma correction and protocol synthesis
decision, action and correction provenance back to transcript segments
backend API authorization, status, export and explicit deletion planning
Podman packaging, Debian deployment packet, backup receipt and one bounded live test
excluded: productive private meeting rollout before a retention and legal-basis policy is selected
unbounded audio, parallel CPU-heavy jobs or realtime guarantees

frozen_decisions.asr_authority: faster-whisper local CPU INT8; raw ASR segments remain immutable
frozen_decisions.asr_runtime_profile: faster-whisper 1.2.1 with a fully pinned Python 3.14 STT lock; Systran/faster-whisper-small revision 536b0662742c02347bc0e980a01041f333bce120 is preloaded explicitly and runtime receives only its resolved local directory
frozen_decisions.review_authority: local Gemma may propose corrections and protocols but may not overwrite raw ASR evidence
frozen_decisions.review_execution: a dedicated local-only Gemma execution path must acquire the shared foreground-aware single-model lease; generic model calls and API fallback are forbidden
frozen_decisions.provider_boundary: local-only; endpoint and browser providers are forbidden in this track
frozen_decisions.audio_acknowledgement: an upload is acknowledged only after bounded streaming, checksum, file fsync, atomic publish, directory fsync and durable job commit
frozen_decisions.protection_truth: stored and backup_protected are separate states; only a verified backup receipt may produce backup_protected
frozen_decisions.speaker_boundary: speaker turns may be unknown or pseudonymous; no biometric identity
frozen_decisions.retention_boundary: source, raw transcript, correction and protocol retention are explicit policy references; the generic upload cleanup scheduler never owns transcription artifacts
frozen_decisions.failure_boundary: processing failure never deletes or overwrites the original audio or raw transcript
frozen_decisions.resource_boundary: one CPU-heavy transcription/correction job at a time with foreground-aware admission on Debian

hard_invariants: No successful upload response exists without a durable owner-scoped artifact and matching database record.
No path is derived from an upload filename, owner name or untrusted media metadata.
No retry creates a second artifact or a second logical job for the same owner and idempotency key.
No transition skips stored or rewrites immutable source digests.
No correction or protocol statement is accepted without segment references.
Names, numbers, dates, decisions and assignees are preserved or marked uncertain; unsupported invention is rejected.
No private audio, transcript, prompt, model output, host path or owner identity is written to routine logs or roadmap evidence.
No external model or transcription endpoint is reachable from the productive pipeline.
No productive private-audio run occurs without a documented legal basis, participant notice/consent contract and retention policy.
No host change, model download, backup, deploy, deletion or live smoke occurs without its matching action-specific live-go entry.

quality_policy.raw_transcript: immutable segment text, start/end timestamps, ASR confidence fields and language evidence
quality_policy.correction: structured proposals with before, after, reason, confidence and exact segment refs
quality_policy.protocol: summary, decisions, action items, risks and unresolved questions with segment refs
quality_policy.automatic_finalization: allowed only when every decision and action has evidence, no critical uncertainty remains and deterministic diff validation passes
quality_policy.fallback: needs_review; never fabricate a clean final protocol

privacy_policy.baseline: local processing and owner-scoped access reduce disclosure risk but do not by themselves establish GDPR compliance
required_before_productive_use: active and documented recording authorization for non-public speech
privacy_policy.live_test_input: synthetic or explicitly consent-cleared German speech, maximum five minutes, no secrets and no intentional special-category data
privacy_policy.logs: content-free identifiers, states, byte counts, durations, model ids and bounded error codes only
